India dominates Sri Lanka in Asian Games cricket; women's team eyes gold

At the 2026 Asian Games, India beat Sri Lanka 16-1 in a cricket match, with Dilpreet Singh taking a hat-trick. The women's cricket competition is scheduled for September 22, and India is aiming for its first gold medal in the sport.
